Use ten source-backed Yes/No factors to consider how intensely to ask for something or say no. Each dime is ten cents in the DIME Game metaphor; it is not real money. A total closer to $1.00 points toward a firmer response.

This guided tool follows **Interpersonal Effectiveness Worksheet 6 and Handout 8**. Completed questions stay visible, and you can change an earlier answer at any time.
